# Longbridge Quant

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. Backtested performance is hypothetical, is easy to overfit, and does not survive contact with live markets unchanged. Curated by Skill Harbor: the quantitative skill of the Longbridge platform, published by the broker itself. It pairs a set of strategy frameworks with a quant CLI command that runs indicator scripts against K-line data pulled through Longbridge. The frameworks cover pairs trading and statistical arbitrage (Engle-Granger cointegration, OLS hedge ratio, z-score signals, half-life of mean reversion); volatility regime strategies that switch between long-volatility and short-volatility structures on historical volatility percentiles; seasonality and calendar effects (month of year, day of week, holiday drift, earnings season); a multi-factor model combining value, momentum, quality and low volatility into a z-score composite with a top-N portfolio; factor research with IC and IR analysis, factor decay and layered backtests; factor screening on valuation, profitability, growth and yield filters; correlation and Johansen cointegration analysis; a statistics toolkit (ADF unit-root tests, GARCH modeling, bootstrap); a strategy optimizer built on parameter sweeps and walk-forward validation; an execution model for slippage, VWAP and TWAP logic and market impact; hedging design (beta hedging, options protection, tail risk, cross-asset); and a machine learning layer using...
